scope: G034 shared calibration plot grid/ticks and logarithmic axes; private C++17 viewport on Windows/Linux

implementation.controls: Plot Axis Limits adds strict Boolean log_x/log_y/grid/ticks; optional API setter fields preserve omitted values. Defaults per new/reset plot: linear axes, grid and ticks enabled.
implementation.log_domain: Finite positive distinguishable endpoints required on log axes, including reversed ranges. View interpolation/pan/zoom operates in logarithmic space; cursor/ticks remain original units. Nonpositive/nonfinite samples are gaps, never connected across; original samples/CSV/source/history unchanged. Visible notice identifies log axes and omissions.
implementation.ticks: Five uniformly spaced screen ticks per nonconstant axis; constant axis has one centered label. Interior grid lines independently toggled. Font-measured margins reserve numeric labels; canvas responds to available area. Automatic nice/minor tick/style options remain open.
implementation.numerics: Private sign-aware C++17 interpolation and scaled fractions; positive/ordered actual log bounds checked atomically. Near max_double, pow(log10(endpoint)) may overflow through rounding: clamp interpolation within its finite endpoints; extrapolation overflow still refuses.
implementation.api: set_intensity_plot_limits requires limits array; optional log_x/log_y/grid/ticks are Boolean only. Same source/All revision and captured dialog plot-generation guards. No public core SDK or dependency change.

verification.native: Windows projection execution and viewport consumers pass; final Linux C++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror viewport consumer passes.
verification.actual_imgui_input: Three installed C++ cases pass; C++/Python calibration cases physically toggle log axes, recover nonpositive-domain error, apply reversed positive ranges, turn grid/ticks off/on, verify tick values and log notice, then refuse stale dialog. Headless actual ImGui input, not an OS/GPU gate.
verification.independent_geometry: Positive measured fit points map to expected logarithmic screen positions; zero-valued measured point is absent. Signed16 table preserves all256 values, masks128 segments and renders127; grid/ticks toggles independent.
verification.numeric_edges: Reversed log interpolation, zero/negative/indistinguishable-domain refusal, underflow/overflow refusal, finite ticks near max_double.
verification.frame_budget_amendment: New log/grid/tick scenario adds88 to previous470;608 explicit cap. Historical reference values/fingerprints unchanged.
verification.limits: Five-tick policy is not full ImageJ tick styling. Linux arithmetic gives no Linux UI/SDK acceptance; no full platform/family or comparative speed claim.
